name: spec
description: Spec pipeline v7 — a small code program run by a trusted engineer, verified by executed evidence. Full lifecycle: greenfield genesis (/spec:genesis, including an in-driver taste-funnel explore state and design-ratification state) → roadmap briefs → /spec:sketch → /spec:plan → /spec:run (design when due, then build, then review, each `--via loop`; /spec:design, /spec:build, and /spec:review remain each stage's direct entry, spec-build-driver.js and spec-review-driver.js stepped: admission, wave derivation, gate resolution, red-check, the final gate, scope-reconcile, legs via review-legs.js + ONE fresh-context reviewer whose non-soft findings carry executed repros, and verdict derived by verdict.js, with test-author dispatch, per-wave worker dispatch, repair, reviewer dispatch, and dispositions held by the session) → /spec:release, plus /spec:atlas, /spec:status, /spec:doctor, /spec:enforce, /spec:escape, /spec:replay. Changelog (last 3): 7.60.0 — disposition-pool unit fix (direct fix, core § Incident Policy): a `leg:<name>` disposition covers that leg’s WHOLE finding count. `spec-review-driver.js --mark dispositions` weighs each leg entry by the same count `verdict.js` sums into legFindings (both now require `lib/leg-findings.js`, the one derivation — reconcile outOfPlan, ac-matrix uncovered, skip-reconcile skipped minus sanctioned, promise-sweep orphans, else 1), prints `count=N` per leg in the DISPOSITIONS step body, and names the leg weight when the tally check refuses. Before: the driver counted one per entry while the verdict counted findings, so one waived reconcile leg with outOfPlan:5 accepted `--waived 1`, derived HARD_FINDINGS forever, and refused `--waived 5` (prax specs/20260902/02-freeze-record.review/). Rejected: per-file refs (changes the disposer contract). Pinned by tests/review/disposer-gate.test.js. 7.59.0 — manifest-stamped review scope (specs/20260902/05-manifest-stamped-scope.md): `review-legs.js` stamps every row it appends with `scope: "full"|"fix-delta"` (its own writer only; `ac-matrix.js`/`promise-sweep.js` rows are unchanged); `verdict.js` derives the review profile's required-leg set from those manifest rows (carriers must agree; none means `full`; disagreement or a value outside the enum invalidates the manifest) and never from the reviewer's return, printing one stderr diagnostic naming the missing legs or the invalid row on `UNVERIFIED`; the review-profile ledger row and retained artifact carry that same manifest-derived `scope` on every row, hard-stop rows included. `spec-review-driver.js --mark dispositions` now refuses (exit 2, no write) when the pass is `UNVERIFIED`, printing the verdict diagnostic plus the sidecar path and the bare re-run command — dispositions cannot cure missing evidence. The reviewer return contract drops `scope`: `spec/commands/review.md` and `spec/agents/reviewer.md` now name `{verdict, survivors, killed, reviewerCount, tokens}`; a return that still carries `scope` is accepted and the key ignored. 7.58.0 — host generators stop planting narration (specs/20260902/04-host-generators-owner-citations.md): init-gen's rendered rules-file Gotchas header, `/spec:review`'s CLOSE fold, and `/spec:escape`'s Gotchas draft all emit tag + rule + one owner citation (spec path, AC-ID, D-number, ADR, run id) and never dates, people, hosts, versions, or prior behavior; the grounding contract states that duty in § Session grounding and is re-hashed (this repo's own `.claude/spec.config.json` re-stamped), and its own three narrated lines are reworded in the same edit. The plugin-wide narration baseline file is deleted — the standing scan runs at zero with no baseline. Hosts: run `/spec:doctor` to approve the contract re-stamp, then apply the check 16 line-item patches it reports.
